plan.notes: Transcribed 2026-11-18 by live browser from Bakersfield College's official Program Pathways Mapper (https://programmap.bakersfieldcollege.edu/, reached from the college's official program-mapper page; no login required or attempted). The map is headed 'Research Laboratory Technology map for 2026-2027' and the pathway is for catalog year 2026-2027. Source map URL is this plan's source_url. Card View and Table View agreed exactly on every course row, term grouping, category, unit value and term total; Table View shows no prerequisites column, so the 'Prerequisites' flags below are Card View only. This plan transcribes the 2026-2027 pathway 'Bakersfield College / Research Laboratory Technology / Associate of Science / 60-62 units / 4 terms / to Degree' in its Pattern A, Cal-GETC form, in full. The program offers four 2026-2027 pathways (Patterns A/B/C Cal-GETC and one plain, all to Degree); per the standing one-plan-per-credential convention only Pattern A is collected. The map prints term totals as 14-16 / 15 / 17 / 14 and a plan total of 60-62 units. Ranged rows: Term 1 'Precalculus I' (4-4.5) and 'Area 1A : English Composition' (3-4.5). Per the standing minimum-credit convention every ranged row is recorded at its printed minimum, so every term sum equals the map's printed term total at its minimum and the plan total is the printed minimum of 60 units. This map was HELD in Wave122 because the first capture grouped rows into terms summing 17/24/12/13 against the printed totals; the 2026-11-18 re-extraction captured all 17 course rows (4 + 4 + 5 + 4) grouped exactly as both views place them, and every term reconciles exactly at minimums, so the hold is cleared. CHEM B2A, the 'Precalculus I' slot and BIOL B3B are printed with the dual category label 'Major / Gen Ed'; CHEM B2A and BIOL B3B are named major courses and the Precalculus I slot is a major requirement slot, so all three are recorded with category 'major'. Term 3 prints two 'Major List A' slots and Term 4 one more; they are recorded as BC-LISTA-1, BC-LISTA-2 and BC-LISTA-3. The two 'Area 4 : Social and Behavioral Sciences' slots (Terms 3 and 4) are recorded as BC-A4-1 and BC-A4-2. CHEM B2A, CHEM B1A, MATH B1B, CHEM B1B and BIOL B3B carry a 'Prerequisites' flag in Card View; no row shows a 'Corequisites' or 'Dual Enrollment' flag, so no other prereqs are recorded. General-education and major-list slots are transcribed exactly as printed as unselected 'Choose a course from ...' choice slots; the option lists behind those slots are not enumerated. Milestone rows printed on the map carry no course content and are not encoded. The map page states verbatim: 'Program maps are for reference only. Make an appointment to create a customized education plan or visit CSU Transfer Planner for more options.'
